it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e assumiu a prefeitura em 03/03/2026, depois que João de Furão renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a deputado estadual na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and took over as mayor on March 3, 2026, after Mayor João de Furão resigned to run for state deputy in the 2026 election.
